rows.failure_note: BOTH FAILED. Literature uses reducing atmosphere (Ar+H2); air calcination gives wrong V oxidation state (need V3+, air favors V5+).
Glass former - amorphous product, low XRD crystallinity.
Published reaction T is very precise at 790C; rounding to 800C may be too high.
Likely insufficient synthesis temperature; also metastable (39 meV/atom above hull).
